title: 第10章 第二次抽奖

content_zh:
林锋辛苦耕耘半天，终于到了收获的季节，看着跟在自己身后的小不点，林锋心情前所未有的愉快。
辞别了石村众人，问明了前往乌州的路径，林锋便带着小不点上路了。
在乌州，还有一个疑似真命天子的萧焱在等着他。
从石村到乌州，要穿过莽莽大山，穿过山中的原始山林。
原始丛林绝不是人类社会中的树林，这点，只有来过的人才能体会到。
遮天蔽日的大树，每年都要生产天文数字的落叶，而在这个潮湿闷热的地方，落叶不可能转化成干燥的土壤，而是经历一个漫长的腐烂过程，与潮湿的泥土一起变成一滩沼泽，成为丛林中最可怕的陷阱。
而林子里的昆虫，要比外面寻常所见的都要大上很多倍，成群飞舞盘旋的蚊子，简直就如同一群群蜂鸟一样！
旁边的树干上挂满了一些绿油油的老树藤，婉转纠缠，一层层一圈圈，可有一次当林锋走过的时候，隐藏在树藤之中，忽然窜出一条遍地碧绿的蛇来！
林锋必须承认，让他一个人在这原始山林中长途跋涉，是一件很要命的事情，不过现在有了小不点，一切就不同了。
别看还不到四岁，但从小生活在大山中的小不点已经是丛林生活的老油条了。
有他在前面开路，林锋一边走一边还有闲暇查询自己的超级祖师系统。
在小不点拜师后，系统中便多出了一个弟子系统分支。
弟子系统的名单里现在还只有小不点一人。
姓名：石天昊
年龄：三岁零七个月
当前修为：练气期二层
潜力属性：根骨—>10；悟性—>8；心志—>8；福缘—>8
备注：肉身力量强悍，远胜于寻常练气期二层修真者。
推荐教育方案：建议修练雷系道法，神通方面可以术法与武道兼修。
林锋满意的点头，正好可以传授小不点九霄天雷正法。

他再次点进了抽奖系统，收小不点为徒，系统可是奖励了一次抽奖机会的。
骰子系统和轮盘系统，林锋都看了一下随机出来的待抽奖物品，略微有些失望，没有什么特别好的东西，只能寄希望于神秘箱子了。
经过上次北极天磁剑，林锋已经知道，这神秘箱子其实就相当于特别大奖，往往能开出好东西。
这次林锋选择了轮盘系统。
虚空中，十八个格子围成一个圆圈，十五件东西摆在其中，外加一个带问号的神秘箱子，另外还余下两个空格。
“箱子，箱子，箱子……开始！”
林锋念头一动，一个光点出现在轮盘上，并开始围着轮盘飞速转动起来。
大约两圈之后，光点的速度慢了下来，林锋紧张的盯着光点，心中算计着光点停下来的位置。
光点越走越慢，距离神秘箱子也越来越近。
接下来的三件东西，分别是法术火焰刀，符箓镇邪符，和神秘箱子。
火焰刀是比火球术、掌心雷这些大路货高一个档次的法术，对于眼下练气期的林锋来说正合适使用，太高档的法术要求太高，反而没那么好使。
镇邪符是通用性很强的一种符箓，专破邪魔阴鬼，虽然是一次性用品，但使用得法，甚至比火焰刀还要实用。
两种东西在兑换系统中都有，全都需要好几百兑换点数。
但它们的吸引力，显然还是比不上神秘箱子。
光点到了火焰刀那里，似乎要停下来，林锋屏住呼吸，不敢发出丝毫响动，心中却在不停大喊：“过，过，过！”
仿佛听见了林锋的心声，光点缓慢的挪过了火焰刀，来到了镇邪符所在的格子。
“再过，再过，再过！”
光点很争气，再次如林锋所愿，挪过了镇邪符。
林锋心里乐开了花，自己运气挺不错的嘛，一共两次抽奖，就都抽到了特别大奖。
“难道我的福缘也很高？”林锋心里美滋滋的想着，眼角向轮盘瞟去，却险些吓得魂飞魄散。

光点竟然还在移动中，眼见就要走过神秘箱子了。
林锋顿时急了眼：“停！停！停……尼玛！”
光点终于颤颤巍巍的停了下来，可是却已经走过了神秘箱子，落在后面一个格子上。
林锋定睛看去，不由一愣。
安魂草。
有镇定稳固神魂之效，灵药定魂丹的主材料，数量稀少，不易寻找。
林锋皱眉，视线定定的盯着已经落到自己手中的安魂草。
他方才感到自己脑海中有一道灵光闪过，似乎这安魂草对自己有大用处。

content_en:
Lin Feng had been working hard for a long time, and finally it was the harvest season. Looking at the little one following him, Lin Feng felt happier than ever.
After bidding farewell to everyone in Shicun and asking about the route to Wuzhou, Lin Feng took the little one on the road.
In Wuzhou, there is also Xiao Yan, who is suspected of being the real one, waiting for him.
From Shicun to Wuzhou, you have to pass through the vast mountains and the primitive forests in the mountains.
The primitive jungle is by no means a forest in human society. Only those who have been there can understand this.
The big trees that block the sky and the sun produce astronomical amounts of fallen leaves every year. In this humid and hot place, the fallen leaves cannot be converted into dry soil. Instead, they undergo a long process of decay and become a swamp together with the moist soil, becoming the most terrifying trap in the jungle.
The insects in the forest are many times larger than those usually seen outside. The mosquitoes flying and circling in groups are just like a group of hummingbirds!
The tree trunks next to it were covered with some green old tree vines, entangled gracefully and in circles. But once when Lin Feng walked by, hidden among the tree vines, a green snake suddenly sprang out!
Lin Feng had to admit that it was a terrible thing for him to trek long distances in this primitive mountain forest alone, but now that he had his little one, everything was different.
Even though he is still less than four years old, the little one who has lived in the mountains since childhood is already a veteran of jungle life.
With him leading the way, Lin Feng had time to check his Super Grandmaster system while walking.
After Xiao Beidian became a disciple, there was an additional branch of the disciple system in the system.
There is currently only one little one on the list of disciples.
Name: Shi Tianhao
Age: three years and seven months
Current cultivation level: second level of Qi training period
Potential attributes: Root—>10; Comprehension—>8; Mind—>8; Fortune—>8
Note: The physical strength is strong, far better than that of ordinary second-level cultivators in the Qi training period.
Recommended education plan: It is recommended to practice thunder Taoism. In terms of magical powers, you can practice both magic and martial arts.
Lin Feng nodded with satisfaction, just in time to teach the little one the Nine Heavens Thunder Method.
He clicked into the lottery system again and accepted the little boy as his apprentice. The system rewarded him with a lottery opportunity.
Regarding both the dice system and the roulette system, Lin Feng looked at the random items for lottery and was slightly disappointed. There was nothing particularly good, so he could only place his hope in the mysterious box.
After experiencing the Arctic Magnetic Sword last time, Lin Feng already knew that this mysterious box was actually equivalent to a special prize, which often yielded good things.
This time Lin Feng chose the roulette system.
In the void, eighteen grids formed a circle, with fifteen items placed among them, plus a mysterious box with a question mark, and two remaining spaces.
"Boxes, boxes, boxes...start!"
As soon as Lin Feng had an idea, a light spot appeared on the roulette wheel and began to rotate rapidly around the roulette wheel.
After about two laps, the speed of the light spot slowed down. Lin Feng stared at the light spot nervously, calculating in his mind where the light spot would stop.
The light spot moved slower and slower, getting closer and closer to the mysterious box.
The next three items are the magic flame knife, the evil talisman, and the mysterious box.
The Flame Knife is a level higher than popular spells such as Fireball and Palm Thunder. It is suitable for Lin Feng who is currently in the Qi training period. Too high-end spells require too much and are not so easy to use.
The evil-suppressing talisman is a very versatile talisman, designed to destroy evil spirits and ghosts. Although it is a disposable item, if used properly, it is even more practical than the flame knife.
Both are available in the redemption system, and both require hundreds of redemption points.
But their appeal is obviously not as attractive as the mysterious box.
The light point reached the flame knife and seemed to stop. Lin Feng held his breath and did not dare to make the slightest sound., but in my heart I kept shouting: "Pass, pass, pass!"
As if hearing Lin Feng's thoughts, the light point slowly moved past the flame knife and came to the grid where the evil-suppressing talisman was located.
"One more time, another time, another time!"
The light spot was very successful, and once again moved the evil-suppressing talisman as Lin Feng wished.
Lin Feng felt very happy. He was very lucky. He won special prizes in two draws.
"Am I also blessed with a lot of luck?" Lin Feng thought happily, glancing at the roulette wheel from the corner of his eyes, but he was almost scared out of his wits.
The light spot was still moving, and he was about to pass the mysterious box.
Lin Feng suddenly became anxious: "Stop! Stop! Stop... Damn it!"
The light spot finally stopped shakily, but it had already passed the mysterious box and landed on a grid behind it.
Lin Feng looked intently and couldn't help but be stunned.
Requiem grass.
It has the effect of calming and stabilizing the soul. It is the main ingredient of the elixir Soul-Calming Pill. It is rare in quantity and difficult to find.
Lin Feng frowned and stared fixedly at the Requiem Grass that had fallen into his hands.
He just felt a flash of inspiration in his mind, and it seemed that this Requiem Grass would be of great use to him.
